messages:
Kayla Zhou: hey team  first day here as infra eng (PST)  super excited. quick intro: came from a small infra team, commute involves a bike and a very opinionated pour-over. fun fact: I collect vintage coffee tins :coffee: :wave; Kayla Zhou: a couple of setup hiccups — my MDM enrollment kept failing at 'Installing profile'. laptop is a MacBook Pro 14. Curious who to ping for a replacement or re-provision if it keeps failing. also need VPN access, SSH to build runners, and repo perms for model-benchmarks; Samir Patel: welcome Kayla!! :tada: Im Samir on infra. Ill be your onboarding buddy this week. Ill DM you to schedule a 20m sync. For now, @IT Support can help with MDM and badge; Alex Gomez: hey Kayla  added you to #platform and #benchmarks. For repo perms, please open a ticket with the repo name and your GitHub handle. Samir and I can approve quickly. For quick SSH workaround, you can use the jump host Ill share in the ticket.; IT Support: Hi Kayla  welcome to Redwood! We saw the MDM failure. Can you confirm macOS version (Apple menu > About This Mac) and whether youre installing on corporate wifi or a home network? Try these steps: 1) remove old profiles (System Settings > Profiles), 2) reboot, 3) reinstall the enrollment link from Okta. If failing, reply here and we'll schedule a remote re-provision or ship a replacement; Kayla Zhou: thanks  macOS 13.5, installing from home wifi. I removed profiles, rebooted, reinstall still errors out at 40%. Happy to do remote re-provision, whats the ETA on that?; IT Support: If remote re-provision needed, we can do it today between 3-5pm PST. ETA for hardware swaps is 2 business days if we ship. We can also temporarily issue a loaner image URL for you to boot from during setup. Which do you prefer?; Kayla Zhou: loaner image sounds great so I can start today. also badge provisioning? need building access. ; HR Bot: Hi Kayla  badge provisioning pending. Ops Bot scheduled a pickup window and will update once the badge locker code is generated. Swag: hoodie + tees queued. Please fill the size form: https://intranet.redwood/swag-form; Ops Bot: Badge locker code will be posted here once ready. In-person tour scheduled tomorrow 10:30am PST. Meanwhile, we added Kayla to the office map for desk assignment.; Samir Patel: once your SSH is sorted, add your public key to GitHub (Settings > SSH and GPG keys). Example: ```bash
# generate if needed
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "kayla@redwood.com"
# copy to clipboard
pbcopy < ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
``` Then clone the benchmarks repo: ```bash
git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/model-benchmarks.git
``` Ill pair on the first PR to get you comfortable with our CI.
; Alex Gomez: small heads-up: join #coffee-club for pour-over discussions and #plant-care if youre into plants. Also, if you want a desk plant, reply with 'yes' and well add one to your desk delivery list.; Kayla Zhou: tagging down notes. going to try the loaner image, will confirm once MDM is resolved. thanks for the warm welcome and the coffee recs  cant wait to meet you all :smile:; Samir Patel: great, see you on the sync. welcome aboard!
